study_identification_part.si_4_title: Cortical thickness deviations as biomarker for subtyping and prognosis in pediatric brainstem tumors

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Data from 849 healthy children were sourced from four sources: (i) 61 locally recruited in Beijing; (ii) 69 from fcon_1000 projects dataset (FCON); (iii) 450 from the Child Connectome Project (devCCNP); (iv) 269 from the Guangzhou Women and Children's Medical Center. Since 2 of 4 sources (Beijing local and Guangzhou hospital) do not match any named dataset in the reference list and the study uses multiple acquisition sites, MULTI-SITE (N>=2) is also applicable.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: To create a normative model, data from 849 healthy children were sourced from four databases: (i) 61 were locally recruited in Beijing; (ii) 69 from the fcon_1000 projects dataset; (iii) 450 from the Child Connectome Project (devCCNP); (iv) 269 from the Guangzhou Women and Children's Medical Center.
